name: OpenResty Lua API
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y wget gnupg lsb-release && wget -qO - https://openresty.org/package/pubkey.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/openresty.gpg && echo 'deb http://openresty.org/package/ubuntu jammy main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/openresty.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y openresty mysql-server
